notes: Read by the get_quote Code node. Edit, then run `node n8n/build.mjs` and re-import the tools workflow (see n8n-setup.md).

Standard.includes: dusting, vacuuming and mopping, kitchen counters and outside of appliances, bathrooms, beds made, trash out

Deep.includes: everything in Standard plus baseboards, inside the oven and fridge, cabinet fronts, light switches, door frames and window sills

Move-in/Move-out.includes: an empty home top to bottom: inside every cabinet, drawer and closet, all appliances inside and out, baseboards and windows from the inside

Post-construction.includes: fine dust removal from every surface, vents and fixtures, paint and sticker residue, floors cleaned twice
